data.rationale: The proposal follows the same Gutenberg → Wikipedia → Notes procedure with the right parameters (title and author) and the right note format. It adds a few minor details: it says to pick the "most-downloaded" result instead of the one matching the author, it doesn't say to avoid downloading the book, and it doesn't mention pressing Enter or using tabs. A browser automation could still be built from it.
